caption: The drawing depicts a formal garden or estate plan viewed from above. The composition is vertically oriented, with a central rectangular layout bordered by a thick, dark green area representing wooded or grassy land dotted with stylized blue and green tree shapes. The top third of the plan consists of a rectangular plot divided into three sections, with a winding white path entering from the right, leading to a circular green feature likely symbolizing a tree, surrounded by yellow shapes that may represent additional trees or shrubs. A long rectangular red feature, possibly a pond or a building, occupies the left-middle area of this section, flanked by small blue circles. Each corner of this section contains a pink triangle, suggesting structures or decorative elements, with small green circles adjacent to them toward the bottom corners. The middle of the drawing features an axial, symmetrical division into eight smaller squares, each filled with intricate geometric patterns in various colors: yellows, golds, greens, pale pinks, and blues. These squares contain designs of circles, swirls, and stylized foliage, indicating formal garden beds or parterres. The lower right section of the drawing shows a coat of arms with a tree, a crown, a red “X,” and a small animal, all on a blue and grey background with a yellow ribbon below that has the word “Fischenich” inscribed on it. The entire garden plot is ringed by a pale yellow border, separating it from the surrounding dark green landscape.
title: Lispenard's Estate and Gardens
